source_instruction: i am looking for a low carbohydrates protein bar with package of 12 counts.
query: The community garden plot I’ve been tending since early spring is finally popping off in the best way this week. The sun-warmed cherry tomato vines are so heavy with fruit I had to prop them up with old paint stirrers I found in my garage last weekend, and the clumps of bright orange marigolds I planted along the edges to keep pests away are drawing so many fuzzy bumblebees I’ve started pausing for five minutes every time I stop by just to watch them bumble from bloom to bloom. Last night I even spotted a tiny baby cottontail rabbit sitting right by the garden fence, munching on a stray dandelion like it owned the whole place, and I had to stand totally still for two whole minutes so I didn’t scare it off before it hopped back into the overgrown empty lot next door. Right now I’m browsing the breakfast foods section, and I know there are 12 count box of low sugar items in this area. I’ve heard those options fit really well for folks who don’t want to spend too much, since they’re the kind of stuff that won’t break the bank. I’ve also heard those exact picks align really well when someone is really trying to stick to their meal plan right now, since the right count and that diet fit are super important for that kind of routine.
